name: influencer.picture_file
description: A new file for one Instagram account's profile picture: our copy of the picture Meta serves, in its type. Answers a signed write URL and the file's stable address, which influencer.picture_set then takes. Internal.
sql: update brandbase.influencer_accounts a set picture_key = :file where a.influencer_id = :id::uuid and a.platform = 'instagram' and a.handle = :handle returning jsonb_build_object('upload', jsonb_build_object('key', a.picture_key, 'type', :mime::text)) as result
